webster.text: Heavy; oppressive; burdensome; as a grievous load of taxes.

more.text: Afflictive; painful; hard to be borne.
Provoking; offensive; tending to irritate; as grievous words.

example.quote: This security does away the objection that me most grievous oppressions might happen under color of punishing crimes against the general government.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
